verdict.rationale: Cactus's docs say the paid platform can be run from 'a coding agent with your API key'. Agent-readable surfaces back this up: a live llms.txt, a documented REST API (generations, tool_schemas, uploads, billing checks), and an OpenAI-style spec at /v1/openapi.json. The root-level OpenAPI probe 404s, but that does not contradict the documented /v1 path. missing for 10: an official MCP server or agent-specific integration guide, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a coding agent actually driving the platform end-to-end.
